reason: I already have my gummies and I reorder them when they run out, so I'm not looking to switch. Nothing here tells me I'd feel different than with what I take now.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I have no reason to think this beats what I already take, and it's made in China, so I'd want more than a lab report to believe it.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews from moms like me saying their sleep or evenings got better, or a free first box so I can try it without risk.
